mapper.select: SELECT b.block_id AS blockId, vb.vitamate_block_id AS vitamateBlockId, b.step_id AS stepId, s.project_id AS projectId FROM block b JOIN vitamate_block vb ON vb.vitamate_block_id = b.type_id JOIN step s ON s.step_id = b.step_id WHERE b.block_id = #{blockId} AND b.type = 'AI' AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND vb.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM step_permission sp WHERE sp.step_id = b.step_id AND sp.user_id = #{userId} AND sp.permission != 'NONE' ) OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM step_permission sp WHERE sp.step_id = b.step_id AND sp.user_id = #{userId} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = s.project_id AND pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.permission != 'NONE' ) ) )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fv.file_version_id) FROM file_version fv JOIN `file` f ON f.file_id = fv.file_id WHERE f.project_id = #{projectId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND fv.deleted_at IS NULL AND fv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND fv.file_version_id IN
#{fileVersionId}

SELECT va.vitamate_analysis_id AS analysisId, b.block_id AS blockId, va.prompt AS prompt, va.analysis_status AS analysisStatus, va.result AS result, va.error_message AS errorMessage, va.request_hash AS requestHash, va.created_at AS createdAt, va.completed_at AS completedAt FROM vitamate_analysis va JOIN vitamate_block vb ON vb.vitamate_block_id = va.vitamate_block_id JOIN block b ON b.block_id = vb.block_id AND b.type_id = vb.vitamate_block_id JOIN step s ON s.step_id = b.step_id WHERE va.vitamate_analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND b.type = 'AI' AND va.deleted_at IS NULL AND vb.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM step_permission sp WHERE sp.step_id = b.step_id AND sp.user_id = #{userId} AND sp.permission != 'NONE' ) OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM step_permission sp WHERE sp.step_id = b.step_id AND sp.user_id = #{userId} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = s.project_id AND pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.permission != 'NONE' ) ) )

SELECT vad.file_version_id AS fileVersionId, f.name AS fileName FROM vitamate_analysis_document vad JOIN file_version fv ON fv.file_version_id = vad.file_version_id JOIN `file` f ON f.file_id = fv.file_id WHERE vad.vitamate_analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND vad.deleted_at IS NULL AND fv.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY vad.created_at ASC, vad.vitamate_analysis_document_id ASC

SELECT vac.rank_order AS rankOrder, vad.file_version_id AS fileVersionId, vac.document_chunk_id AS documentChunkId, dc.page_number AS pageNumber, vac.excerpt AS excerpt FROM vitamate_analysis_citation vac JOIN vitamate_analysis_document vad ON vad.vitamate_analysis_document_id = vac.vitamate_analysis_document_id JOIN document_chunk dc ON dc.document_chunk_id = vac.document_chunk_id WHERE vac.vitamate_analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND vac.deleted_at IS NULL AND vad.deleted_at IS NULL AND dc.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY vac.rank_order ASC
